periods.label: Sea King and regeneration goddess
periods.occupation: Sea King; Noah/N ally; later nursery assistant
periods.affiliation: Lectea goddesses / Noah; Child Nursery Tamachi (cover)

status.notes: captured by Kinji then semi-cooperative prisoner; returns from Lectea after escorting China

periods.summary: Livia is a colorful mermaid goddess who uses harp magic for curses, weather, water blades, teleportation and healing lullabies. She attacks Kinji at Suez, later invades his apartment, is captured, takes a human form and works as nursery assistant 'Satomi Asako', then becomes essential negotiator and transporter for China and Gedronika matters.

kinji.summary: fights, is captured by and later cooperates with him; develops favorable view of human males

china.summary: regresses her but later protects and escorts her to treatment

moriarty.summary: appears with him at Suez and coordinates with Noah

gedronika.summary: tries to reason with her and brokers post-battle pact

memet.summary: Memet helps capture and supervise her

key_events.summary: attacks Kinji/Aria and the submarines with multiple harp spells
invades Kinji's bath and is defeated with a kotatsu cord
transports China via water transfer and returns after half a year subjective time
